title: Require Domain Module Entrypoint Shape
forbids: semantic module entrypoints that compose runtime code or expose operations, rules, strategies, routers, or owners outside their artifact and model surfaces
why: A semantic module index is one declaration-only public gateway. The contract names the module, the router binds executable implementations, and only immutable products or shared model vocabulary may cross the module boundary as named exports.
remediate: Default-re-export ./contract.js and keep additional exports explicit and named from ./artifacts/index.js or ./model/{atoms,policy}. Move operations and runtime composition behind the module router.
message: Domain module index.ts must expose only its contract plus named artifact or model surfaces.
